paper.title:
Physics of Language Models: Part 3.1, Knowledge Storage and Extraction Thanks: Project page: https://physics.allen-zhu.com/part-3-knowledge/part-3-1 . An extended video of this paper is available at https://youtu.be/YSHzKmEianc .

result.summary: 本文研究语言模型如何在预训练中记忆知识并在推理时提取知识，区分了“逐字记忆”与“可提取的知识存储” [S1.p3][S1.p4]。作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS 和 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并通过混合训练、预训练+指令微调、线性探测等方法进行控制实验 [S1.p6][S2.p1][S5.p1]。主要发现是：仅预训练传记后微调 QA 无法提取知识，而知识增强（如多版本、句子打乱、重复全名）能显著提升提取能力，并使知识几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中 [S1.p8][S4.SS2.p3][S5.SS2.p4]。作者据此建议在预训练阶段对关键但稀疏的数据进行改写增强，并提前引入 QA 类数据 [S1.p9][S8.p2][S8.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：语言模型回答事实性问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（数据污染/传统记忆），还是真正从维基百科等来源中提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种机制，因此需要可控实验来研究模型如何在训练中记忆知识并在推理时提取 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?

leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data

method.text: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个体，每人六句传记，每句从约 50 个模板中随机选择）和 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4]。采用两种训练方式：预训练+指令微调（先在传记上预训练，再用一半人的 QA 微调）和混合训练（同时用全部传记和一半人的 QA 训练） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。此外，提出基于位置的探测（P-probing）和基于查询的探测（Q-probing）两种近乎线性的探测方法，以分析知识在隐藏状态中的编码位置和方式 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: The synthetic dataset, bioS, generates profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
We generate a six-sentence biographical text entry for each individual, highlighting six distinct aspects. For diversity, each sentence is randomly chosen from approximately 50 distinct templates.
We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.

Here, we pre-train the language model from scratch on the BIO data, randomly sampling and concatenating them into 512-token sentences, separated by a standard <EOS> token. The model is then fine-tuned using half of the QA data and evaluated on the remaining half
In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing). Both methods employ simple, nearly-linear probes to extract personal attributes from the model’s hidden states.

experiments.text: 实验在 bioS 和 bioR 数据集上进行，使用 GPT2/Llama 架构（bioS 用 124M 模型，bioR 用 302M 模型），并额外测试了 682M 模型和 BERT 变体 GBERT [S2.SS1.p1][S7.p2]。评估指标为 QA 生成准确率，测试集为未在训练中见过 QA 的个体（OOD 设置） [S2.p6][S3.p1]。知识增强实验包括多版本（multi M）、句子打乱（permute）和重复全名（fullname） [S4.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
Only in Figure 2 when presenting a negative result, we tried a 12-layer 32-head 2048-dim GPT2 (682M).
We call this modified model GBERT.
QA accuracy is measured by the proportion of answers that exactly match the correct response.
The model’s generative accuracy is then tested on the QAs from the remaining individuals ( ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) to assess its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability.
We focus on three augmentations: adding multiplicity, introducing permutations, and repeating full names, typically found in internet data.

findings.text: 混合训练能使模型有效提取知识，在 bioS single 上 OOD 准确率达 86.6%，bioR single 上达 77.7% [S3.p2]。但仅预训练传记后微调 QA，模型在测试集上准确率为零，即使模型规模远大于数据量、个体被暴露上千次 [S4.SS1.p2]。知识增强能大幅提升提取能力，例如每人 5 个多样化传记条目将 QA 微调准确率从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。探测实验表明，知识增强使属性几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中，Q-probing 准确率与 QA 微调准确率高度相关 [S5.SS2.p4]。此外，加入“名人”数据能显著提升“少数群体”的 QA 准确率（如 bioS 从 4.4% 到 86.8%） [S6.p4]。双向模型（GBERT）在 MLM 预训练后难以提取知识，除非知识是独立单词 [S7.p8]。

evidence.quote: the OOD generalization accuracies are $86.6\%$ when mixed-trained on bioS single and $77.7\%$ for bioR single.
the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters.
This holds true even when the model size is $\sim$ 7000x larger than $N=100k$, with each individual exposed 1350 times during pretraining

Pretraining on a dataset where each person has 5 diverse biography entries (i.e., different wording, sentence shuffling) boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.

The QA finetune accuracy correlates closely with Q-probing accuracy, indicating that the “degree to which the attribute is directly linked to the person’s name” is a crucial factor for effective knowledge extraction.
Introducing celebrity data boosts the minority group’s QA accuracy (e.g., from 4.4% to 86.8% for the bioS data).
Unless the knowledge is a standalone word or of independent words (like month, day, year), extracting knowledge after MLM pretraining might prove challenging, if not totally impossible.

limitations.text: 作者指出，本文主要使用合成和 Llama 生成的数据，可能无法完全反映真实互联网数据的复杂性 [S8.p1]。此外，研究聚焦于事实性知识，未涉及逻辑推理或知识操作，后者留待后续工作 [S1.p6]。对于双向模型，实验仅在 bioS 数据家族上进行以展示负面结果 [A8.p1]。

evidence.quote: Using synthetic data allows for greater control over the training and fine-tuning of models, which is essential for understanding how different data sources impact the internal mechanisms of transformers.
We leave the follow-up question to study logical reasoning or manipulation on knowledge to a separate paper.
Since we only apply GBERT to the bioS data family to demonstrate a negative result, we utilize the same architecture size as GPT2-small.
